programs.title: Motel Rescue
programs.desc: In Ventura, Calif., Lindsey is called to renovate an old motor lodge, and the owner's sons need to be taught how to run the place; Lindsey's up for the challenge, but it's a tall task.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The crew helps a couple turn their chopped up, suburban cabin into the spacious, rustic Maine getaway they've always wanted; with the help of some new faces and upgraded equipment, the Cabin Masters breathe new life into this family's retreat.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The Cabin Masters head to Snow Pond to renovate a generational camp with a tight budget and deadline. Facing heat, supply issues, and surprises, they work hard -- yet still find time for games, laughs, and helping Ashley reconnect with an old friend.
